admission.justification: One owning storage design was weighed against the canonical database and rejected for its complexity and unreadable history.

alternatives.option: Markdown prose plus JSON sidecars in Git are the source of truth; SQLite is only a derived, uncommitted index
alternatives.reason: Git keeps the knowledge readable, reviewable and durable, and the database complexity disappears.

alternatives.option: The canonical knowledge database stays the source of truth
alternatives.reason: It mandated the changeset merge, schema generations, snapshots, candidate and batch plumbing and comparison-dataset copies, and left unreadable history.
alternatives.reconsider_when: The record count grows past about 100,000 or writers appear outside Git.

consequences: One file writer serves converted memory.
The published dataset location is one declared path per memory layer.
context: The canonical-database design left about 22,000 lines of storage-only machinery and two sources of truth for one memory layer.
decider: Developer ruling D18 (2026-09-28), text-canonical layout Doc14
